title: Sound is synthesised at boot and played through a rate-limited player
intent: Original audio with no files, that never turns a crowd into a wall of noise

evidence.description: sfx recipes, Sfx player, Profile v2

constraints.statement: Every effect is a recipe rendered once into a Web Audio buffer by createSfx; no audio files are loaded
Sfx.play enforces per-sound minimum gaps and a 20-voice cap; only weapons, the player's own hurt and the Giant's slam bypass the cap
Settings (shake, volume, mute) live in Profile version 2, which migrates the old boolean screenShake
